det.analysis: call → called: 전체 이야기가 과거 시제이고 절의 본동사 자리이므로 과거형 called
det.tip: 과거형: call → called

questions.passage: When I woke up in our hotel room, it was almost midnight. I didn't see my husband nor daughter. I called them, but I heard their phones ringing in the room. Feeling worried, __________, but they were nowhere to be found. When I decided I should ask someone for help, a crowd nearby caught my attention. I approached, hoping to find my husband and daughter, and suddenly I saw two familiar faces. I smiled, feeling calm. Just then, my daughter saw me and called, "Mom!" They were watching the magic show. Finally, I felt all my worries disappear.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 맞게 영작하시오.

나는 밖으로 나가 거리를 걸어 내려갔다.

[조건] (1) and, down, I, outside, street, the, walked, went를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 8단어로 쓸 것 (영어로)

det.korean: I went outside and walked down the street
det.analysis:
본문: 'I went outside and walked down the street, but they were nowhere to be found' — 과거동사 went과 walked가 and로 병렬

[조건 검증] I(1) went(2) outside(3) and(4) walked(5) down(6) the(7) street(8) = 8단어
det.tip: went and walked = 병렬 과거동사 / walk down the street = 거리를 걸어가다

questions.wa: I went outside and walked down the street
accept: I went outside and walked down the street

다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 단어를 바르게 배열하시오. (영어로, 8단어)

나는 그들의 휴대폰이 방에서 울리는 것을 들었다.

[단어] heard / I / in / phones / ringing / room / the / their

det.korean: I heard their phones ringing in the room
det.analysis:
본문: 'I heard their phones ringing in the room' — 지각동사 heard + 목적어(their phones) + 현재분사(ringing)

어순: I + heard + their phones + ringing + in the room
det.tip: 지각동사 hear + 목적어 + 현재분사(ringing)

accept: I heard their phones ringing in the room

갑자기 나는 낯익은 두 얼굴을 보았다.

[조건] (1) faces, familiar, I, saw, suddenly, two를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 6단어로 쓸 것 (영어로)

det.korean: suddenly I saw two familiar faces
det.analysis:
본문: 'and suddenly I saw two familiar faces' — 부사 suddenly + 주어 I + 과거동사 saw + 목적어(two familiar faces)

[조건 검증] suddenly(1) I(2) saw(3) two(4) familiar(5) faces(6) = 6단어
det.tip: familiar faces = 낯익은 얼굴 / 부사 suddenly(갑자기)

questions.wa: suddenly I saw two familiar faces
accept: suddenly I saw two familiar faces
